newsitem.title: ESTONIA: HANSA INVESTMENTS COMPLETES OLAINE PLACEMENT.
newsitem.headline: HANSA INVESTMENTS COMPLETES OLAINE PLACEMENT.

text.p: Hansa Investments said on Thursday that it had completed the private placement of Latvia's Olaine Pharmaceutical plant with 25 investors buying 35.3 percent of its outstanding stake.
"The placement is split evenly between foreign institutional investors and non-Latvian regional investors," John Wilson, the managing director of Hansa Investments, told Reuters.
The price of a one-lat par value share was 2.5 lats, he said. Olaine's share capital is worth three million lats.
Wilson said that some private investors sold their stake in the pharmaceutical company.
Olaine management is also preparing the listing of its shares on the Riga Stock Exchange, Wilson added.
